title: Three Seasons and One Short Fence
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：pig　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pig 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the keeper ① raised the pig that no child in the zoo would have recorded, and he said the raising was the whole of the season. The ② pig, meaning the animal itself and not the fence, ran three seasons and stayed unrecorded in the book; a pig, he said, is the only thing in a zoo that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ pig in that zoo had the same short fence beside it, and the ④ pig at the far shed, meaning the calf they kept for the children to feed and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A pig, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the keeper said the recording is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pig was the whole of the matter, meaning the greed and not the animal. The ⑥ pig, meaning the greed and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; pig, he said, is either something you raise or the only word that means both an animal and a greed. He said the greed is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ pig had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short fence. The ⑧ pig of the whole thing, the keeper wrote in March, was one zoo and three seasons of recording; pig, he said, is either the calf at the far shed or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pig I remember is the animal recorded in the register, which closed in 1981 and is still recorded as the quietest in the zoo. A ⑩ pig, my mother said in 1983, is the only animal that improves by being recorded; every pig, she said, is a greed that has agreed to look like an animal. She said the greed was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 猪（指兽舍里每一头旁边的那一头）
B. n. 猪（指那头猪本身，与矮矮的围栏相对）
C. 固定搭配：raise the pig 养这一头猪
D. n. 猪（指留给孩子们喂的那一头）
E. n. 猪之事（抽象总称，指一处兽舍的猪之事）
F. n. 猪（指饲养台账里写到、被记载的那一头）
G. n. 猪、贪念（指一件事里人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 贪念（抽象总称，指人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: raised the pig that no child in the zoo would have recorded
The pig, meaning the animal itself and not the fence
the pig at the far shed
the pig was the whole of the matter
the pig had become a line in a register
The pig of the whole thing
A pig, my mother said in 1983

answers.why: raise the pig 意为“养这一头猪”，1974 年那位饲养员把兽舍里没有一位孩子肯记载的一头猪做了一遍。
pig 意为“猪”，指那头猪本身而不是矮矮的围栏，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被记载。
pig 意为“猪”，指兽舍里每一头旁边的那一头，每一头旁边都有同一道矮矮的围栏。
pig 意为“猪”，指最远那间棚舍的留给孩子们喂的那一头，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pig 意为“猪、贪念”，指一件事里人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这头贪念就是那件事的全部。
pig 意为“贪念”，指人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西而不是那头猪，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pig 意为“猪”，指饲养台账里写到、被记载的那一头，到 1979 年这一头成了饲养台账里的一行。
pig 意为“猪之事”，饲养员三月写道，整件事的猪之事是一处兽舍和三个季度的记载。
pig 意为“猪”，我记得的是饲养台账里记载过的那一头，1981 年养大了，至今仍被说成兽舍里最安静的一头。
pig 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，猪是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的猪。
